name: Tuition Hub
summary: An evening tuition academy in Lahore: batches, a paper-style register, marks on a chalk board, fees in PKR
about: A nine-page desk for a made-up evening academy in Johar Town, Lahore, running Matric, FSc and O-Level batches from 4 to 9 PM. The register fills like a paper one, each tick drawn as a pen stroke, and test marks grow as chalk bars on a blackboard. Timetable clash checks, fee vouchers with reminders and late fees, teachers' salaries, parents' messages and a results day report all work and keep their data in the browser.
how: Open a page from the top bar: Today, Batches, Students, Attendance, Marks, Fees, Teachers, Messages or Results
On Attendance, tap a box to mark present, absent, late or on leave, or press Mark all present and watch the pen run down the column
On Marks, pick a test, type the marks and save: the board is wiped and the new bars are drawn in chalk
Make next month's fee vouchers, record a payment, print a three-part voucher and remind overdue parents
Add a period on the timetable (clashes are refused), pay a salary and send a message to a parent
Press Ctrl+K to jump to any page, student or action; change the academy details or reset the demo data in Settings
